body: Hello @mithandir, when that hang happens, can you get us around 2-3 thread dumps (using `jstack` against the quarkus process) with an interval of around 2 seconds between them?
@mithandir Could you pls try your app with 1.3.0.Alpha2? I know that we fixed few issues related to template extensions recently...
I just released the staging repository of Alpha2 so it's not yet on Central. It should be there in ~1 hour.
I will have a look later on.
@mithandir Did you get a chance to test it?
Yesterday Alpha2 wasn't available on maven central. Will be home in about an hour, then I can start checking the issue on Alpha2.
I could test it now. Unfortunately, it isn't fixed in Alpha2.

Do you get the same error? We do have a test for a template extension method that accepts multiple parameters: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/extensions/qute/deployment/src/test/java/io/quarkus/qute/deployment/TemplateExtensionMethodsTest.java#L95.
@mithandir I think the easiest way to get this fixed would be for you to provide a small Maven project reproducing the issue. Thanks!
Ok, no problem. Will create a small version of it tomorrow.

Here you go: https://github.com/mithandir/quarkus-quote-template-bug

- Start it
- Call http://localhost:8080/working to get a version with 1 parameter that works
- Call http://localhost:8080/error to get a version with 2 parameter that doesn't work
@mithandir Thanks a lot! I'll take a look later today.

issue.title: Qute - ExtensionMethodGenerator now handles ClassCastException correctly
issue.body:
- also fix parent context resolution for multiple nested levels
- resolves #7144
